title: Homology modeling of Forkhead box protein C2: identification of potential inhibitors using ligand and structure-based virtual screening.
authors: Ibrahim, Mayar Tarek; Lee, Jiyong; Tao, Peng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模和虚拟筛选寻找FOXC2蛋白抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合域但核心是药物发现，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Overexpression of Forkhead box protein C2 (FOXC2) has been associated with different types of carcinomas. FOXC2 plays an important role in the initiation and maintenance of the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) process, which is essential for the development of higher-grade tumors with an enhanced ability for metastasis. Thus, FOXC2 has become a therapeutic target for the development of anticancer drugs. MC-1-F2, the only identified experimental inhibitor of FOXC2, interacts with the full length of FOXC2. However, only the DNA-binding domain (DBD) of FOXC2 has resolved crystal structure. In this work, a three-dimensional (3D) structure of the full-length FOXC2 using homology modeling was developed and used for structure-based drug design (SBDD). The quality of this 3D model of the full-length FOXC2 was evaluated using MolProbity, ERRAT, and ProSA modules. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation was also carried out to verify its stability. Ligand-based drug design (LBDD) was carried out to identify similar analogues for MC-1-F2 against 15 million compounds from ChEMBL and ZINC databases. 792 molecules were retrieved from this similarity search. De novo SBDD was performed against the full-length 3D structure of FOXC2 through homology modeling to identify novel inhibitors. The combination of LBDD and SBDD helped in gaining a better insight into the binding of MC-1-F2 and its analogues against the full length of the FOXC2. The binding free energy of the top hits was further investigated using MD simulations and MM/GBSA calculations to result in eight promising hits as lead compounds targeting FOXC2.
abstract_zh: Forkhead box protein C2（FOXC2）的过表达与多种类型的癌相关。FOXC2在上皮-间质转化（EMT）过程的启动和维持中发挥重要作用，该过程对于具有增强转移能力的高级别肿瘤的发展至关重要。因此，FOXC2已成为开发抗癌药物的治疗靶点。MC-1-F2是唯一已鉴定的FOXC2实验性抑制剂，它与FOXC2的全长相互作用。然而，只有FOXC2的DNA结合域（DBD）具有解析的晶体结构。在本工作中，利用同源建模开发了全长FOXC2的三维（3D）结构，并用于基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）。使用MolProbity、ERRAT和ProSA模块评估了该全长FOXC2 3D模型的质量。还进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟以验证其稳定性。进行了基于配体的药物设计（LBDD），针对ChEMBL和ZINC数据库中的1500万个化合物，为MC-1-F2寻找相似类似物。从该相似性搜索中检索到792个分子。通过同源建模，针对FOXC2的全长3D结构进行了从头SBDD，以识别新型抑制剂。LBDD和SBDD的结合有助于更深入地理解MC-1-F2及其类似物与FOXC2全长的结合。使用MD模拟和MM/GBSA计算进一步研究了顶级命中物的结合自由能，最终得到八个有前景的命中物作为靶向FOXC2的先导化合物。
